title: Numerical degree under Fourier substitution
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every real-valued function $p$ on the sign cube $\{ -1,1\}^n$, the numerical degree of the function obtained by substituting the coordinatewise sign encoding of a binary input into $p$ equals the Fourier degree of $p$.
